resource: One encoded normative ANL-01 EventEnvelope carrying event type 3 BANK_OPERATION, including payload
allocation_impact: Check the encoded or borrowed envelope length before retaining, decoding, batching or publishing; ANL01-EVENT-ENVELOPE-BYTES (262,144 B) still applies on top. Migration 0071 sets the stored bank outbox ceiling to this row.
boundary_tests: the measured worst-case envelope (128-byte build id) is exactly 26,255 B and accepted
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/bank.rs (bank writer: checked before any ledger entry, coin line, balance change or event; a typed refusal or error writes no value)
notes: BANK-0 §8 (owner answers 1b and Q1 b; ARCH-BATCH-ROOT-PACKETS-V1 §1.8 and §2.4); registered by BANK-1; E12 adds536 bytes for the bounded named-House Hireling scope (512-byte key,16-byte identity and protobuf framing), measured by the existing worst-case test. Channel bytes remain unchanged.
